title: From a lighting idea to a consultation
label: Scripted two-voice simulation
description: A focused enquiry, a useful comparison, an email correction and one consented demo booking.
outcome: Demo booking confirmed in the script
actions: Availability and booking illustrated with mocked results

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [warmly] Hi, Harbour and Oak. I'm Maya, the AI design concierge. This demo is recorded. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hi! I like my kitchen, but the lighting's awful. I'd love soft light in the evening and something brighter when I'm cooking.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [thoughtful] Separate ambient and under-cabinet lighting would give you both, with independent controls. Our illustrative Focus and Glow concept is six hundred and fifty pounds, before installation.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That sounds good. What would I lose with the cheaper option?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Soft Glow is three hundred and fifty pounds for ambient lighting. It doesn't include bright task lighting, so Focus and Glow is the closer match.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Right, let's explore that. Could I book a video consultation on Monday, the fifth of October, at one, London time?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Of course. It's a twenty-minute demo consultation. What's your full name and email for the invitation?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Alex Morgan. It's alex dot morgan plus lighting underscore seven, at example dot com.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [patiently] Alex dot morgan, plus lighting, underscore seven, at example dot com. Is that complete address exactly right?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Ah, sorry. Eight, not seven. Everything else is right.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: No problem. Alex dot morgan, plus lighting, underscore eight, at example dot com. Is that exact address correct?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, that's correct.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: And what's the best number for a callback? It can be different from the number you're calling on.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Use my other number. Plus four four, two zero, seven nine four six, zero nine five eight.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Plus four four, two zero, seven nine four six, zero nine five eight. Have I got that right?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: You have. And please tell the designer I only want lighting, not a whole new kitchen.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Absolutely. Monday, the fifth of October, one p.m. London time, for twenty minutes. Notes: lighting only, soft evening light, brighter cooking light and separate controls. Shall I send the demo invitation with those notes?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, please send it.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I'll check that time and arrange the demo invitation.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [warmly] Your demo consultation is confirmed for Monday, the fifth of October, from one to one twenty p.m. London time. The invitation was requested with your lighting notes.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Brilliant. Should I have anything ready?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: A couple of room photos or measurements would be helpful, if you have them. No payment is needed for the demo consultation.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Lovely. Thanks, Maya. Bye!

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: You're welcome, Alex. Have a lovely afternoon. Goodbye!

title: A landline caller, without the email frustration
label: Scripted two-voice simulation
description: Useful storage advice, two uncertain email repairs and a clear callback request for human review.
outcome: Callback request retained; no invitation created

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [warmly] Hi, Harbour and Oak. I'm Maya, the AI design concierge. This demo is recorded. What can I help with?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Hello. I'm on my landline. My kitchen's small, and finding anything in the cupboards is a nightmare. I don't want a full redesign.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Pull-out storage and drawer organisers could help you reach things more easily. Our Everyday Order concept has an illustrative four hundred and fifty pound budget, subject to dimensions.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: That's more like it. Could someone talk me through the options?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: We can explore a demo consultation. What's your name and email for the invitation?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Sam Reed. The email starts sam dot reed. Then there's an underscore, I think, and maybe a five. The domain's something like oak mail.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Let's take just the uncertain part. After sam dot reed, is it an underscore followed by the digit five?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: It might be six. I'm sorry, I don't have it written down.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: That's all right. Could you check the complete address, including the domain, before I send anything?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: No, this is getting a bit frustrating. And I can't get a text on this phone.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [reassuring] Let's leave the email there. I can record a callback request for human verification instead. I won't send an invitation to an uncertain address.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes, that would be much easier.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: What's your preferred callback number?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Plus four four, two zero, seven nine four six, zero nine four one.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Plus four four, two zero, seven nine four six, zero nine four one. Is that exactly correct?

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Yes. Please say I'm interested in better storage, without replacing the kitchen.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: [warmly] I've retained that callback request for operator review: better access to storage, no full redesign. No appointment has been booked, and there's no need to keep spelling the email.

turns.speaker: Caller
turns.text: Thank you. That's a relief. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: You're welcome, Sam. Goodbye!
